DML.SELECT: SELECT command_element_type_id as "commandElementTypeId", element_type_id as "elementTypeId", element_id as "elementId", xAddress as "xAddress", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.modbus_element_command_element_types WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.modbus_element_command_element_types (command_element_type_id, element_type_id, element_id, xAddress, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:commandElementTypeId , :elementTypeId , :elementId , :xAddress , :enabled , :visible , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM conf.modbus_element_command_element_types WHERE command_element_type_id = :commandElementTypeId AND element_type_id = :elementTypeId AND element_id = :elementId
